meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商图片文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性文案生成，适用于电商平台的商品营销推广

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为电商商品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为电商产品快速撰写吸引眼球的文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for ecommerce products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly write eye-catching copy for ecommerce products

howto.what: 为电商商品生成带 emoji 的四段式 Markdown 图片文案：先收集产品信息，按品类选模板，产出标题和正文；也能对已有文案做标题、正文、emoji 与格式优化。
howto.when: 当用户提出电商文案创作、文案优化，或需要为电商商品生成营销文案时触发。

say.text: 帮我写这段保温杯的电商文案，卖点是保温12小时和便携。
say.note: Claude 会先询问产品信息，再按相关品类模板生成文案。

say.text: 优化这段口红文案，标题加点 emoji，突出显白。
给这款智能台灯创作图片文案，目标用户是学生。
say.note: Claude 会收集信息后选择智能家居模板产出四段式文案。

howto.what_en: Generates emoji-rich four-paragraph Markdown image copy for e-commerce products: first gathers product info, picks a template by category, and produces title and body; can also optimize existing copy's title, body, emoji, and formatting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for e-commerce copywriting, copy optimization, or marketing copy for a product.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for this thermos, highlighting 12-hour insulation and portability.
say_en.note: Claude asks for product info and generates from a relevant template.

say_en.text: Optimize this lipstick copy, add emoji to the title and emphasize a brighter look.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the original and adjusts title, body, and emoji.

say_en.text: Create image copy for this smart desk lamp targeting students.
say_en.note: Claude gathers info and uses smart-home template to produce copy.
